How it gets made

Process →
  1. 01

    Work out what the film is

    Before anything gets made, one sentence has to hold: what happens, and to whom.

  2. 02

    Find the look

    Reference first, then a small set of rules — palette, lens, how light behaves in this world.

  3. 03

    Build the sequence

    Shot by shot, in order, held against continuity: the same face, the same room, the same time of day.

  4. 04

    Cut, grade, finish

    The edit decides the rhythm — where it breathes and where it moves.
